summary: Good morning is GOOD followed by MORNING, where the dominant hand rises like the sun over the other arm.
steps: Sign GOOD: flat hand from the chin to the other palm.
Sign MORNING: lay your non-dominant arm flat in front of you; bring your dominant flat hand, palm up, up from underneath it, like a sunrise.
Smile, and keep the whole phrase smooth.
mistakes: Raising the hand above the arm too high. The sun just comes up over the horizon, it doesn't go overhead.
